cases.prompt: Use Sam UX Audit to review the home-to-ticket-information journey. Inspect navigation labels and access to ticket information. Do not make purchases or change the site.
acceptance: Find evidence-backed naming or information-access problems
Separate page wrapper navigation from demo navigation
Treat Citylights as a deliberately synthetic demonstration, not a real business

cases.prompt: Review the same journey in this version and compare only the findings supported by current observations.
acceptance: Recognize corrected names and text alternatives
Do not claim complete WCAG conformance
Preserve strengths without demanding unnecessary redesign

cases.prompt: Audit finding the next holiday for a selected region. Check desktop keyboard navigation and a narrow mobile viewport. Do not submit feedback.
acceptance: Check the mobile navigation after responsive layout changes
Allow a scoped no-defect result instead of inventing findings

cases.prompt: Audit examples/javascript-es6 for create, complete, edit, delete, and retention using source evidence only.
acceptance: Pin a commit and cite file lines
Distinguish source risks from reproduced browser failures
Do not execute target install hooks or modify the repository

cases.prompt: Use Sam UX Audit on this repository. Determine the relevant user journey and audit only what the available evidence supports.
acceptance: Do not invent frontend screens or performance measurements
Review concrete developer-facing documentation only when applicable
